test "WITH current distinct-aggregate-order public source parses" {
  for
    text in [
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT name, '|' ORDER BY name) AS names FROM labels",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT name, '|' ORDER BY l.name) AS names FROM labels AS l",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.name, '|' ORDER BY (`l`.`NAME`)) AS names FROM labels AS l",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) FROM labels |> AGGREGATE STRING_AGG(DISTINCT name, '|' ORDER BY name DESC NULLS LAST) AS names",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) FROM labels AS old |> SET name = 'changed' |> AGGREGATE STRING_AGG(DISTINCT old.name, '|' ORDER BY old.name) AS names",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(name, '|' ORDER BY id) AS names FROM labels",
      "WITH labels AS (SELECT id, CAST(amount AS STRING) AS name FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT name, '|' ORDER BY name) AS names FROM labels",
      "WITH objects AS (SELECT id, @payload AS payload FROM records WHERE id > 0) SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (payload).name, '|' ORDER BY objects.payload.`NAME`) AS names FROM objects",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT x IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY p.x DESC) AS items FROM pair AS p",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p.x IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY x DESC) AS items FROM pair AS p",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ((x)) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY (`p`.`X`) DESC) AS items FROM pair AS p",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) FROM pair AS p |> AGGREGATE ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT x IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY p.x DESC) AS items",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p.x IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY (x) ASC) AS items FROM pair AS p",
      "WITH limited AS (FROM records |> WHERE id > 0 |> ASSERT UNIQUE BY (id) |> ORDER BY id |> LIMIT 4) , pair AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(amount, 0) AS x FROM limited) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT x IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY p.x DESC) AS items FROM pair AS p WHERE x >= 10",
    ] {
    let script = parse_query_script(text, query_limits()).unwrap()
    assert_true(query_binding_count(script_query(script)) > 0)
  }
}
